c74object.name: evi_polyblep_shapes
c74object.digest: A GenExpr file, part of 'evieve', for using via 'require()'
c74object.description:
evi_polyblep_shapes.genexpr is a .genexpr file and is part of the 'evieve' Package.
It is for using in a gen.codebox~ or in another .genexpr file via the require() command.
By declaring require("evi_polyblep_shapes.genexpr"); at the top of a codebox you can then access all of the functions included in this file.
The evi_polyblep_shapes.genexpr file also requires:
evi_polyblep_utility.genexpr
evi_polyblep_two.genexpr
About this File:
This file offers interesting bandlimited oscillator shapes beyond the usual boring 'classic' waveforms. These shapes are by Theo Niessink, thank you! See the source code for more information. This file also inherits 'evi_polyblep_two.genexpr' so can be used to call any of the two-point PolyBLEP Oscillators in evieve.

entry.name: poly_half ( )
entry.description:
Half wave rectified Sine, antialiased PolyBLAMP
In 1: type=input: t, Phase 0..1
In 2: type=input: dt, Phase increment
Return 1: Sine, Bandlimited Sine Rectified

entry.name: poly_half2 ( )
entry.description:
Half wave rectified Sine with PWM, antialiased PolyBLAMP
In 1: type=input: t, Phase 0..1
In 2: type=input: dt, Phase increment
In 3: type=input: pw, PWM 0..1 morphs between +pulse..full_wave_rectified_sine
Return 1: Sine, Bandlimited Sine Rectified
